lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12V4Cu4 (reduced formula Mg3VCu) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Cu and V each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg centers show 12 neighbors with varying Mg, Cu, and V compositions, with neighbor distances from about 2.92 to 3.26 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mg coordination polyhedra, as well as edge-sharing between Cu and Mg polyhedra.
